images.alt: Problem formulation maximizing advertising and recommendation utility under an application-level monetization-rate cap and request-level placement constraints
Notation table for request utility, exposure counts, monetization rate, dynamic-knapsack value and weight, strategies, and threshold
Request value defined as utility over the no-ad baseline and request weight defined as the number of ad exposures
Dynamic-knapsack objective with request selection, strategy-dependent value and weight, capacity, top-slot, and minimum-gap constraints
Greedy application-level selection of requests above a value-per-weight threshold until knapsack capacity
Request-level tradeoff between direct value gain and value lost by displacing requests near the application threshold
Request-level derivation of the threshold-penalized objective and final ad-versus-no-ad decision
Beam-search tree interleaving ranked recommendation and ad queues while pruning invalid nodes and retaining the top beam
Exposure-template search algorithm expanding recommendation and ad slots, enforcing constraints, and retaining the top beam
Final exposure-template rule selecting the best beam-search candidate only when its value per weight exceeds the threshold
